reason: An image-focused DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds vision-model image analysis and local image processing tools, with optional external API backends and local caching.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图片问答、目标定位以及裁剪、OCR、像素比较、取色和抠图等本地视觉工具。
summaries.en: Adds image question answering, target localization, and local tools for cropping, OCR, pixel comparison, color extraction, vector tracing, and foreground extraction to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Analyzes images through configured vision APIs
Reads image files for local crop, pixel comparison, color extraction, OCR, tracing, and foreground extraction
Writes generated image outputs and caches recognition results locally
Supports configurable external OpenAI-compatible endpoints and local Ollama backends
